messages:
nina: Quick sync 10am 15m: CloudForge + AccelEdge co-hosted webinar on Jun 12 confirmed. Need speaker roster, demo plan, and promo assets by EOD Fri.

tom: Great. Do we have agreed topics?

nina: CloudForge wants focus on marketplace integration & provisioning. AccelEdge wants to highlight on-prem performance w/ their inference cards. We propose a single combined demo: self-serve deploy from CloudForge -> AccelEdge hw + fallback to Redwood hosted.

alejandra: I can craft the deployment script demo. Prefer 3-step flow: 1) publish model on CloudForge, 2) deploy to AccelEdge node, 3) simulate network drop and show Redwood hosted failover. Keeps it compact.

kevin: Timing? 40m session? 18m demo, 12m panel, 10m audience Qs. That keeps it tight.

nina: 40m works. Speakers: CloudForge PM (Laura), AccelEdge Eng Lead (Marco), plus Redwood eng (kevin) and product (nina). Need bios by 5/20.

oliver: AV/streaming note: We'll use StreamYoshi account. Need RTMP + captioning enabled. promo-bot: Draft promo post ready with event link placeholder.

promo-bot: Marketing wants 2 variations of the blurb: developer-facing (80 words) and executive-facing (40 words). Deliver by 5/22.

alejandra: Dry-run? Recommend 5/28 for 45m rehearsal (include full deploy + failover). I'll run the infra checklist.

kevin: I'll own the demo instrumentation: latency graphs, token counts, and cost delta between on-prem and hosted. Need sample workload from AccelEdge by 5/18.

nina: Swag/fulfillment: AccelEdge requested co-branded laptop stickers and a limited run of engraved bottle openers. We have 100 sticker packs and 50 openers in SF. Shipping to venue requires customs forms for international partner reps.

oliver: Suggest we do voucher cards for EU attendees if customs is risky. Also offer downloadable wallpapers and a promo code for free trial credits.

kevin: Action list:
- Speakers & bios by 5/20 (CloudForge/AccelEdge/Redwood)
- Sample workload + model size constraints by 5/18 (partners)
- Dry-run 5/28 (alejandra + kevin)
- Final deck 6/5 (nina)
- Promo copy 5/22 (marketing)
- Swag final decision 5/21 (nina + partners)

promo-bot: Adding event to calendar and creating shared drive for assets now. Please drop logos (SVG) into /shared/partners/cloudforge-acceledge.

nina: Minor ask from partners: AccelEdge needs <16GB model or quantized variant. CloudForge wants clear notes on provisioning steps for the marketplace screenshots.

alejandra: We'll build fallback slides with screenshots in case live deploy flaps.

oliver: Who's moderating? Tom can MC, Kevin will handle deep technical Qs.

tom: Happy to MC. Quick rundown to partners: please confirm availability for dry-run 5/28 and send bios by 5/20.

nina: Thanks team. I'll compile tasks in Asana and ping marketing. If no blockers, we'll reconvene Fri EOD. :rocket:
